name: get_mempolicy
synopsis: long get_mempolicy(int *mode, unsigned long nodemask[(.maxnode+ULONG_WIDTH-1)/ ULONG_WIDTH], unsigned long maxnode, void *addr, unsigned long flags);
description: get_mempolicy() retrieves the NUMA policy of the calling thread or a specific memory address, depending on the flags. On a NUMA system, this policy determines from which memory node allocations are made for the thread.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Pointer to store the policy mode and optional flags

parameters.name: nodemask
parameters.description: Array to store the nodemask associated with the policy

parameters.name: maxnode
parameters.description: Specifies the number of node IDs that can be stored in nodemask

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Memory address for which to retrieve the policy, or NULL if flags is 0

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to determine what information to retrieve, such as MPOL_F_ADDR or MPOL_F_NODE

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Part of all of the memory range specified by nodemask and maxnode points outside your accessible address space
The value specified by maxnode is less than the number of node IDs supported by the system, or flags contain invalid values, or other invalid combinations as specified
